local n = 0
for i = 0, _SkillInventory.skillCount - 1 do
 local e = _SkillUI.skillScroll.Entity:GetChildByName('SkillSlot_' .. tostring(i))
 if isvalid(e) and e.Enable then
  assert(_SkillInventory:GetSkillGrade(i) == 1, 'Grade filter failed')
  n = n + 1
 end
end
assert(n > 0, 'No normal skill shown')
log('[LobbyPanelsQA] gradeFilter=true count=' .. tostring(n))

local n = 0
for i = 0, _SkillInventory.skillCount - 1 do
 local e = _SkillUI.skillScroll.Entity:GetChildByName('SkillSlot_' .. tostring(i))
 if isvalid(e) and e.Enable then assert(_SkillInventory:GetSkillCharacter(i) == 1, 'Character filter failed'); n = n + 1 end
end
assert(n > 0, 'No Sylph skill shown')
log('[LobbyPanelsQA] characterFilter=true count=' .. tostring(n))

local s = _SkillUI.skillScroll
assert(math.abs(s:GetScrollNormalizedPosition(UITransformAxis.Horizontal) - 0.5) < 0.02, 'Skill scroll failed')
s:SetScrollNormalizedPosition(UITransformAxis.Horizontal, 0)
log('[LobbyPanelsQA] skillScroll=true')

assert(_RelicUI._upgradableOnly == false, 'Relic filter did not restore')
assert(math.abs(_RelicUI.relicScroll:GetScrollNormalizedPosition(UITransformAxis.Horizontal) - 0.5) < 0.02, 'Relic scroll failed')
_RelicUI.relicScroll:SetScrollNormalizedPosition(UITransformAxis.Horizontal, 0)
log('[LobbyPanelsQA] relicFilterAndScroll=true')

assert(_RankUI._boardId == _RankUI.BoardIdTimeAttack, 'Rank tab failed')
assert(_RankUI.tabTimeAttack.Entity.SpriteGUIRendererComponent.ImageRUID.DataId == '0cfbd6e3aa6845abb4a42659d01b6078', 'Rank active art failed')
log('[LobbyPanelsQA] rankTab=true')

assert(_ShopUI.skinPanel.Enable and not _ShopUI.scrollTouchArea.Enable, 'Shop skin tab failed')
assert(_ShopUI.tabSkin.Entity.SpriteGUIRendererComponent.ImageRUID.DataId == '0cfbd6e3aa6845abb4a42659d01b6078', 'Shop active art failed')
log('[LobbyPanelsQA] shopSkinTab=true')

local v = math.min(0.5, _ShopUI._maxScrollNorm)
assert(math.abs(_ShopUI.productScroll:GetScrollNormalizedPosition(UITransformAxis.Horizontal) - v) < 0.02, 'Shop scroll failed')
_ShopUI.scrollBar.Value = 0
local panel = _EntityService:GetEntityByPath('/ui/TitleGroup/ShopPanel')
assert(not panel:GetChildByName('BtnPrev').Enable and not panel:GetChildByName('BtnNext').Enable, 'Shop arrows visible')
for i = 0, _ShopUI.itemCount - 1 do
 local card = _ShopUI.productScroll.Entity:GetChildByName('ProductCard_' .. tostring(i))
 assert(card.SpriteGUIRendererComponent.ImageRUID.DataId == '4b108a37c9634258a6cd558c592a77d1', 'Old product frame returned')
end
log('[LobbyPanelsQA] shopScrollAndNoArrows=true')

local root = _EntityService:GetEntityByPath('/ui/TitleGroup').UITransformComponent
local original = root.RectSize
local cases = {Vector2(1920,1080), Vector2(2048,960), Vector2(2560,1080), Vector2(1440,1080)}
local frame = _EntityService:GetEntityByPath('/ui/TitleGroup/SkillPanel/Frame').UITransformComponent
local content = _EntityService:GetEntityByPath('/ui/TitleGroup/SkillPanel/ContentSurface').UITransformComponent
for _, size in ipairs(cases) do
 root.RectSize = size
 _MobileScreenFitLogic:FitLobbyPanelArt()
 local expected = math.min(1, (root.RectSize.x - 40)/1880, (root.RectSize.y - 170)/903)
 assert(math.abs(frame.Scale.x - expected) < 0.001 and math.abs(content.Scale.x - expected) < 0.001, 'Panel containment scale failed')
 local x = frame.anchoredPosition.x
 _MobileScreenFitLogic:FitLobbyPanelArt()
 assert(math.abs(frame.anchoredPosition.x - x) < 0.001, 'Repeated fitting grew UI')
 log('[LobbyPanelsQA] contain=' .. tostring(size.x) .. 'x' .. tostring(size.y) .. ' scale=' .. tostring(expected) .. ' stable=true')
end
root.RectSize = original
_MobileScreenFitLogic.DebugForceMobile = true
_MobileScreenFitLogic:FitTabBar()
_MobileScreenFitLogic:FitLobbyPanelArt()
for _, p in ipairs(_MobileScreenFitLogic:GetLobbyPanelPaths()) do
 local panel = _EntityService:GetEntityByPath(p)
 local bg = panel:GetChildByName('Bg').UITransformComponent
 local m = _MobileScreenFitLogic:MeasureScreenLoose(panel.UITransformComponent)
 assert(m ~= nil, 'Background screen measure failed')
 assert(bg.anchoredPosition.x - bg.RectSize.x/2 <= m.x0 and bg.anchoredPosition.x + bg.RectSize.x/2 >= m.x1, 'Horizontal background gap')
 assert(bg.anchoredPosition.y - bg.RectSize.y/2 <= m.y0 and bg.anchoredPosition.y + bg.RectSize.y/2 >= m.y1, 'Vertical background gap')
end
_MobileScreenFitLogic.DebugForceMobile = false
log('[LobbyPanelsQA] measuredBackgroundCoverage=true mobileDebug=false')
